title: Partner incident challenge
scenario: Your partner causes one problem in the shop, you cause one in theirs. Find it and protect customers as quickly as you can.
why: Explain the fault and check the shop before stopping the timer.
assignment: Who can explain the problem and protect customers faster?

fields.label: 1. Record the baseline
fields.prompt: Before introducing any faults, both partners record normal stock, delivery information and the relevant Grafana readings on their own machines.

fields.label: 2. Introduce a fault and start the timer
fields.prompt: Each partner introduces one fault on the other partner’s machine without revealing it. Once both faults are active, each of you starts your own timer.

fields.label: 3. Identify the problem
fields.prompt: Use Grafana and Storefront to identify the fault on your machine. Record the evidence that led you to your diagnosis without looking at the fault settings.

fields.label: 4. Mitigate and test
fields.prompt: Apply a mitigation while keeping the fault active. Test it using Storefront and Grafana. What changed, and did the mitigation work?

fields.label: 5. Record the fault, mitigation and impact
fields.prompt: While the timer is still running, record the fault you identified, the mitigation you used and its impact compared with your baseline.

fields.label: 6. Stop the timer and compare
fields.prompt: After recording your results, stop the timer. Record both partners’ times. Who identified the problem, tested a mitigation and documented the result faster?

competition.title: Timed partner round
competition.rules: Your partner applies one fault and says go. Start the timer. Leave the fault on. Explain the cause, choose your settings. Working products must stay usable. Missing information must be clearly marked and wrong values must be hidden. Then stop the timer. Removing the fault does not count as a fix. Who was faster?
competition.record: Record both times, faults and settings below. Agree on what a good result looks like before the round.
